subject: Consolidated forecast stitch & account playbook for QBR
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: laura.bennett@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com, vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com, jane.doe@acme.com
Cc: 
Date: 2026-11-12T15:08:00-08:00
Subject: Kickoff: QBR forecast consolidation & account playbooks

Team — looping Acme to ensure aligned timeline for the QBR next week. I attached a blank consolidation template (20261112-QBR_forecast_template.xlsx). Request: please populate account-level notes and a short one-line ask for leadership for each named account by EOD Nov 14.

Minimum deliverables per account:
- Committed ARR / expected close date (best estimate)
- Key blocker(s) (procurement, legal, PoC schedule)
- Customer ask (discount, SLA, case escalation)
- One-sentence recommended play (owner + next step)

Acme: Jane, can you confirm procurement milestone for the PO and whether the legal redlines will be concluded before the close date you shared in the discovery call? If helpful, we can slot a 30-min touch on Friday.

Attachments: [Attachment: 20261112-QBR_forecast_template.xlsx (XLSX, 180KB)]

Thanks — Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
karthik@redwood.com
From: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, marissa.cole@redwood.com, vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com
Cc: jane.doe@acme.com
Date: 2026-11-13T09:22:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff: QBR forecast consolidation & account playbooks

Thanks Karthik — filled in the Acme playbook draft and attached a one-pager (ACME_account_playbook_v1.pdf). Summary highlights:
- Forecast: $640k ARR, 60% commit, target close 11/30 (procurement is the gating item).
- Blocker: Legal is asking for a data residency clause — engineering ok but legal needs vendor-side answer.
- Ask: We should offer a 3-month SLA credit and push for a canary export agreement to satisfy residency concerns.

Quick note: Acme asked about a potential volume discount if they sign before EOY. I recommend we discuss thresholds with revenue ops before committing in the deck.

Attachment: [Attachment: ACME_account_playbook_v1.pdf (PDF, 240KB)]

—Laura

Cc: procurement@acme.com
Date: 2026-11-13T14:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff: QBR forecast consolidation & account playbooks

Karthik / Laura — thanks for the template and the summary. A couple quick clarifications from our side:
- Procurement milestone: PO expected by 2026-11-26, internal legal sign-off scheduled for 11/24.
- Data residency: our legal team requires a written runbook/controls summary; happy to accept a limited export agreement in the interim.

I attached our internal timeline (Acme_PO_timeline.docx) so you can slot things into your QBR narrative. A 30-min call on Friday works for me — suggest Friday 11/14 at 10:00 PT.

Attachment: [Attachment: Acme_PO_timeline.docx (DOCX, 95KB)]

Best,
Jane Doe
Head of Cloud Procurement | Acme Corp
jane.doe@acme.com

Date: 2026-11-14T08:46:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff: QBR forecast consolidation & account playbooks

Team — I consolidated the incoming account sheets into one file and ran through a quick roll-up (attached). Key line items:
- Net pipeline this block: $4.1M (weighted forecast = $1.9M)
- Movement since last update: +$320k (Acme moved from 40% to 60% confidence based on legal schedule)
- Top risks flagged: procurement lead times (Acme), PoC bandwidth (Nimbus), and pricing sensitivity (HealthCo).

I left a short comment next to Acme indicating that legal needs the controls summary; Laura, if you can drop a one-paragraph controls nugget I’ll paste it into the account playbook.

Attachment: [Attachment: 20261114-consolidated-forecast.xlsx (XLSX, 210KB)]

—Marissa

marissa@redwood.com
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>

Cc: jane.doe@acme.com
Date: 2026-11-14T17:55:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff: QBR forecast consolidation & account playbooks

Appreciate the quick turn, Marissa and Laura. A couple of operational items before I build the leadership narrative tomorrow morning:
1) Laura — please paste the one-paragraph controls nugget into the consolidated sheet (Marissa called out cells H14-H16).
2) Marissa — can you include a delta column in the consolidated sheet that shows the last 30-day movement (positive/negative) so leadership can see velocity?
3) Jane — confirmed for Friday 11/14 10:00 PT; I’ll send the invite. If PO moves to 11/26 we should mark the account as commit-but-conditional in the slide.

Quick draft summary for the deck (use as-is):
- Acme Corp — Weighted: $384k (60%); Ask: short-term SLA credit + controls runbook; Close note: PO due 11/26 pending legal sign-off.

Attached is the early draft of the QBR deck with placeholders. Please don’t redistribute outside this thread.

Attachment: [Attachment: QBR_deck_draft.pdf (PDF, 2.1MB)]

Thanks — Karthik
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, laura.bennett@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Cc: jane.doe@acme.com
Date: 2026-11-15T11:03:00-08:00
Subject: Finalized QBR materials and next steps

Thanks everyone — looked over the consolidated workbook and the deck. Marissa, good catch on the movement column; that made the narrative tighter. Laura, your controls paragraph worked well in the Acme playbook.

Status:
- Consolidated forecast updated and shared to leadership drive (link below).
- Final deck sent to execs at 11:00 PT. Included a note to hold on volume discount commitments until rev ops clears thresholds.

Final links: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1abcd/view
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/12345678

Next steps:
- Karthik: present Acme slide in Tuesday readout (you have the speaking slot).
- Marissa: prepare a 1-slide risk heatmap for the exec Q&A.
- Laura: be on the readout to handle the legal/residency question.

Closing — appreciate the tight turnaround.

—Vivek
